spatialSubset: bbox 46.5,40.5,87.3,55.5 then Natural Earth Kazakhstan polygon
cohort: type=0; MODIS confidence >=30; VIIRS nominal/high; valid UTC and D/N; exact satellite-time-coordinate deduplication
assignment: For each VIIRS pixel select closest eligible Aqua pixel by haversine distance, then absolute UTC lag, then stable satellite/time/coordinate key. Each VIIRS record assigned once. Sum assigned VIIRS FRP per Aqua pixel. Unmatched Aqua/VIIRS are missing comparisons, not zero fire.
fit: Nonnegative OLS through origin using all matched 2024 Aqua-pixel / VIIRS-neighborhood groups. Freeze coefficient and training-only VIIRS mean before 2025 evaluation. At least 20 training groups required.
baselines: mean VIIRS group FRP from 2024 only
evaluation: 2025 MAE, RMSE, bias; 500 deterministic UTC-day-block bootstrap replicates for calibrated minus identity RMSE. Seed 2024. No ground-truth validation claim.
limitations: 2 km is an analyst-set center-distance gate, not an actual MODIS pixel footprint.
No cloud/coverage/view-angle correction; only mutually detected sites; selection bias remains.
Overpass times are taken from actual timestamps, not assumed from nominal orbit.
No burned area, confirmed wildfire cause, operational accuracy, or historical reconstruction inferred.
2024 has previously been inspected; only 2025 outcomes are held aside for this protocol. Sensitivity is reported, never used to choose a winner on 2025.
